audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeats, in five separate fields, that Warwick's Q and passive 'heal more the lower YOUR HP is'. Both halves are wrong. It also never mentions Primal Howl (E) at all.
audit.why: Riot text — Q Jaws of the Beast: 'dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt' (max health, not missing health; 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s). P Eternal Hunger: 'If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples' — keyed to HIS health, not yours. W Blood Hunt senses enemies below 50% for move/attack speed, which is the only part that keys off your health. E Primal Howl: 'gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second' — 15/14/13/12/11s.
audit.corrected: Q scales on your max health and fully heals him. Eternal Hunger turns on when HE drops below 50% and triples below 25% — so the danger is leaving him alive at low HP, not being low yourself. Primal Howl eats your burst for 2.5s and then fears you out of the Bladesurge chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill/Warwick/Warwick/Skill/Skill/Warwick/Warwick, which inverts levels 1-5 against the packet chart and against the whys text beside it.
audit.why: Level 1 is his (max-health bite, no Irelia stun). Level 2 is a wash. Level 3 is Irelia's first real window with Flawless Duet. 4-5 go back to him on Blood Hunt stickiness. Level 6 is Irelia's kill window with Vanguard's Edge. First item onward is his.
audit.corrected: Warwick, Skill, Irelia, Warwick, Irelia, Warwick, Warwick — matched pairs both layers.

audit.why: Spike ordering is right — Irelia at 3 and 6, Warwick at 1-2 and from first item once Infinite Duress is up.

edits.before: "Warwick wins the very early game because his Q (Jaws of the Beast) and passive on-hit both heal harder the lower YOUR HP gets, so any extended trade just feeds his sustain. At level 1 you only have Bladesurge — don't walk up to fight, last-hit with Q off minions and keep your HP topped, because the moment he bites you low his heals snowball. Level 2's Defiant Dance can tank one Q with its damage reduction, but your real answer is level 3: E-stun into a Q-reset is the only combo that holds him still long enough to win a short trade. Bait nothing until you have it."
edits.after: "Warwick wins the very early game because Jaws of the Beast (Q) tears a share of your MAX health and heals him for everything it deals, so any extended trade just feeds his sustain. At level 1 you only have Bladesurge — don't walk up to fight, last-hit with Q off minions and keep your HP topped. Eternal Hunger heals him on every auto once HE drops under 50%, and triples under 25%, so a half-finished trade is a gift. Level 2's Defiant Dance can tank one Q, but your real answer is level 3: E-stun into a Q-reset is the only combo that holds him still long enough to win a short trade."

notes: Core factual error corrected: Warwick's healing was described as scaling off IRELIA's missing health. Q scales on the target's MAXIMUM health, and Eternal Hunger keys off Warwick's own health (50% / 25% thresholds). Only Blood Hunt keys off the target being under 50%. Primal Howl (E) — 2.5s damage reduction into a 1s fear — was absent from every field and is now in the Do's. packet.defects' two suspect names ('Blood Hunt's', 'Defiant Dance's') are FALSE POSITIVES: both are correct names with a possessive apostrophe.
